summary: Tested BuildMitra Help & Support Hub (/help) frontend-only across all 3 roles (worker, contractor, client) + Hindi i18n. Profile→help-support-link now correctly routes to /help. All hero/contact/quick-actions/FAQs/how-to-use/about sections render with correct role-specific content. FAQ accordion works (faq-0 initially open; tapping faq-1 closes prev, opens new; tap-again toggles closed). Contact (WhatsApp/Call/Email) buttons tap without crashing. goto-complaints navigates to /complaints. goto-bug navigates to /complaints?type=bug without crashing. Hindi labels render correctly. No new bugs found. Only known issue is help-title testID missing (H2 component does not forward testID — confirmed pre-existing, flagged in AGENT_TO_AGENT_CONTEXT_NOTE).

react_native_issues.issue: H2 component does not forward testID prop, so [data-testid="help-title"] is missing from DOM on /help screen. Reference: /app/frontend/src/ui.tsx (H2 definition line ~79). Known pre-existing issue per main-agent context note; no new regression.

action_items: (Low-priority, known) Forward testID prop in H2 (and other typography components in src/ui.tsx) to underlying Text element so help-title and similar headings become testable from Playwright/RNTL.
critical_code_review_comments: help.tsx (430 lines) is approaching the 700-line file-size budget — fine for now but consider splitting FAQ/step data into a separate file (e.g. src/data/helpContent.ts) for maintainability and future i18n growth.
Hard-coded support contact constants (phone/whatsapp/email) inline in help.tsx — fine for MVP, but worth moving to env / a single contact config to avoid duplication if used elsewhere.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: from /role-select, tap role (e.g. 'I am a Worker'), then tap 'Continue' button (bottom), then fill 2 inputs with mobile+password, then tap last 'Login' text (bottom button — there are 3 'Login' text instances on screen). Use page.locator('text=Login').all() then click [-1]. Profile tab is the last 'Profile' text element. /help screen has all expected testIDs (contact-whatsapp, contact-call, contact-email, goto-complaints, goto-bug, terms-link, privacy-link, faq-0..N, help-back) except help-title (H2 doesn't forward testID — known).
